candidates.name: EnumServicesStatusEx
verified_facts: EnumServicesStatusEx enumerates services and can return extended status information
Buffer sizing, resume handle, service type, state filters, and process identifiers must be recorded
semantic_limits: Enumeration can be incomplete if access rights, filters, or pagination are mishandled

candidates.name: QueryServiceStatusEx
verified_facts: QueryServiceStatusEx returns the most recent service status information reported to the service control manager
Extended status can include a process identifier and checkpoint/wait-hint data
semantic_limits: Reported status is not a substitute for process start-time and command-line correlation

candidates.name: QueryServiceConfig2
verified_facts: QueryServiceConfig2 retrieves optional service configuration information
The requested information level and returned buffer must be recorded
semantic_limits: Configuration does not prove current execution or successful recovery

candidates.name: SERVICE_STATUS_PROCESS
verified_facts: SERVICE_STATUS_PROCESS contains service state, accepted controls, exit codes, checkpoint, wait hint, and process ID fields
A nonzero process ID is meaningful only while the service is running
semantic_limits: Process IDs can be reused and require start-time and image-path correlation

candidates.name: QueryFullProcessImageName
verified_facts: QueryFullProcessImageName retrieves the full executable image name for a process handle
Native or Win32 path form and buffer sizing must be recorded
semantic_limits: An image path alone does not prove command-line arguments or task ownership

candidates.name: GetProcessTimes
verified_facts: GetProcessTimes returns creation, exit, kernel, and user times for a process
Creation time can disambiguate PID reuse when joined with other identity evidence
semantic_limits: Time values do not prove command-line identity or liveness after the query

candidates.name: ProcessIdToSessionId
verified_facts: ProcessIdToSessionId maps a process identifier to its session identifier
Session ID helps distinguish interactive, service, and remote-session contexts
semantic_limits: Session membership does not prove ownership or authorization

candidates.name: Process Handles and Identifiers
verified_facts: Process identifiers are unique only while a process exists and can be reused
Process handles are subject to access checks and remain the stable reference for subsequent queries
semantic_limits: A PID-only receipt is insufficient for durable identity

candidates.name: GetProcessInformation
verified_facts: GetProcessInformation retrieves a selected class of information for a process
The information class, structure size, process handle rights, and result must be recorded
semantic_limits: Unsupported classes or insufficient rights can produce incomplete evidence

candidates.name: IsProcessCritical
verified_facts: IsProcessCritical determines whether a process is considered critical by the system
The result can be used as a fail-closed safety gate before any termination consideration
semantic_limits: A false result does not authorize termination and no process mutation is performed

candidates.name: GetExtendedTcpTable
verified_facts: GetExtendedTcpTable retrieves TCP endpoint tables with selectable table classes, address families, and owner detail
The two-pass buffer size, address family, table class, PID, addresses, ports, and state must be recorded
semantic_limits: Endpoint snapshots are time-sensitive and can change immediately

candidates.name: GetOwnerModuleFromTcpEntry
verified_facts: GetOwnerModuleFromTcpEntry retrieves module information for a specific IPv4 TCP owner-module row
The exact endpoint row must be preserved for the module query
semantic_limits: The issuing module is not necessarily the current application-level owner

candidates.name: GetTcpTable2
verified_facts: GetTcpTable2 retrieves IPv4 TCP connections with owning process identifiers and offload state
The table is a point-in-time inventory that must be joined to process creation time
semantic_limits: PID reuse and rapid endpoint churn require immediate correlation

candidates.name: GetTcp6Table2
verified_facts: GetTcp6Table2 retrieves IPv6 TCP connections with owning process identifiers
IPv6 addresses, scope information, ports, state, and PID must be captured
semantic_limits: IPv6 endpoint presence does not prove application protocol success

candidates.name: GetExtendedUdpTable
verified_facts: GetExtendedUdpTable retrieves UDP endpoint tables with selectable address family and owner detail
Buffer sizing, table class, PID, local address, and local port must be recorded
semantic_limits: UDP has no connection state and an endpoint snapshot does not prove traffic flow

candidates.name: GetOwnerModuleFromUdpEntry
verified_facts: GetOwnerModuleFromUdpEntry retrieves module information for a specific IPv4 UDP owner-module row
The exact UDP row and sizing result must be preserved
semantic_limits: Owner-module data does not prove receipt production or runner ownership
